## Rule

**Column gravity-sort** (LIVE graph is literally named `task078_col_sort`). Per column:
count the color-1 cells (`n1`) and color-2 cells (`n2`); the output column is `n1`
ones stacked from the top, then `n2` twos directly below, background everywhere else.
Colors used: {0,1,2} only (200k-corpus census). Every corpus grid is **exactly 10×10**
in AND out (`corpus.build(78)` in/out shapes min==max==[10,10] over 200k —
CROP-CONTRACT satisfied; the 10×10 crop is generator-bounded/safe).
Verified: numpy oracle == ARC-GEN ground truth 2000/2000; == officials 266/266.

## Algorithm sketch

```python
n1  = (col == 1).sum()          # per column
n12 = n1 + (col == 2).sum()
out_col[r] = 1 if r < n1 else 2 if r < n12 else 0
```

## Cost analysis

LIVE 15,756 (mem 15,720 + 36p) wastes: 5,600 B zeroing ch3-9 via two [1,7,10,10] F32
tensors (a Pad does it free), ~6,000 B on 15 [1,1,10,10] F32 clamp-chain intermediates,
4,000 B on an F32 [1,10,10,10] concat.

**v1 = 1,611** (mem 1,560 + 51p), static opset-12, `_score_v2` exact (#39):
- The decoder thresholds at `>0.0`, so output channels only need the right SIGN.
  With half-integer offsets nothing lands on 0: `g0=(r+.5)-n12` (ch0), `g1=n1-(r+.5)`
  (ch1), `ch2=g0*g1` via ReduceProd — both-positive is impossible (n1≤n12), so the
  product is positive exactly on the color-2 band. No Relu/clamp chains at all.
- Counts read free from `input` (#46): `Einsum('bchw,kjc->bkjw', input, sel[2,1,10])`
  emits `[-n12, n1]` as [1,2,1,30] F32 (240 B); the size-1 `j` subscript avoids an
  Unsqueeze. Slice cols→10 (80) → Cast F16 (40) → one broadcast Add vs `rmat[1,2,10,1]`
  builds BOTH planes as [1,2,10,10] F16 (400). ReduceProd→ch2 (200), Concat (600),
  output-named Pad restores ch3-9 + 30×30 canvas uncharged.
- All values quarter-integer multiples ≤ ~110 → F16-exact (ort_reality §11).
- Byte breakdown: 240+80+40+400+200+600 = 1,560 mem; params 20 sel + 3 slice + 20 rmat + 8 pads.

**v4 = 842** (mem 800 + 42p), opset-13, 8 nodes — the bool-tail ladder end:
- Digit-packing: ONE einsum with sel coefficients {color1: **101**, color2: **100**}
  emits `packed = n1 + 100·n12` per column ([1,1,1,30] F32, 120 B). `ch0 =
  Greater(100r+50, packed)` is valid **directly on packed** — n1 ≤ 10 < 50 can't
  flip a hundreds-scale comparison (margin ≥ 40). `n1` recovered with one
  `Mod(packed, 100, fmod=1)` (const divisor — no SIGFPE class; probed on CPU EP).
- Tail: `ch1 = Greater(n1, r+.5)`, `ch2 = Equal(ch1, ch0)` (XNOR — both-false is
  exactly the color-2 band; both-true impossible since n1 ≤ n12). BOOL Concat →
  BOOL Pad 'output'. Every comparison tie-free (margin ≥ 0.5, exact F32 ints).
- Bytes: 120 + 40 (col-slice) + 40 (Mod) + 3×100 (bool planes) + 300 (cat) = 800.

**Floor argument (842 = comparison-family floor; 338-style ledger)**

Hard lower-bound decomposition — every term forced, zero glue:
- Per-column count signal: cheapest input-reading op is a weighted Einsum →
  [1,1,1,30] F32 = **120 B** (w=30 forced before any slice; F32 forced by input
  dtype; unweighted `ReduceSum(input)` reads free too but only yields the useless
  constant n_all=10/column — weights require Einsum).
- Column restriction to 10: Slice = **40 B** + 3p (sel-side masking ≥ 300 params; dead).
- A second independent count digit: `Mod` = **40 B** + 1p. Mathematically required:
  ch1 membership `{packed : packed mod 100 > r+.5}` is a union of intervals, not a
  half-line ⟹ no single comparison on `packed` expresses it; the alternative is a
  second einsum stream (+120 B, = v3). Fractional-radix packing gives one clean
  compare only — same structure, tie.
- Three output planes ≥ 3 × [1,1,10,10] BOOL = **300 B** (1 B/elem is the narrowest
  legal plane dtype; ch2 as interval needs both bounds ⟹ ≥ 3 distinct planes).
- Single graph output ⟹ single final Pad ⟹ pre-Pad [1,3,10,10] ≥ **300 B** BOOL
  (Pad reads ONE tensor; mode=edge/reflect channel synthesis is semantically wrong;
  Concat-with-zeros7 instead of Pad = 700 params; two-Pad assembly impossible —
  one output).
- Params: sel 10 + two row-ramps 20 (scales differ; sharing via `Mul(s1,100)` costs
  +40 B for −10p, dead; `Range` generator = 43 cost vs 10, dead) + pads 8 + slice 3
  + divisor 1 = **42**.

Σ = 120+40+40+300+300+42 = **842 — achieved by v4.** Sub-842 requires one of: a
sub-1-byte plane dtype (none), a non-Pad 3-channel output assembler (none in
ai.onnx), or a free input-read below 120 B (none). Scorer-side exploit surface
also audited (scoring_internals A.2): output-named-Pad + free input reads already
used; symbolic-dim undercount validator-rejected (dim_param) + §39-repriced;
sparse scorer-rejected (task337); sub-byte packing net-loss <1000 elems;
ConstantOfShape fully accounted post-fix. No loophole below 842. Dead-end ledger this session:
stacked-Greater+bool-slices tail (+200), opset-20 Not/ReduceMax(BOOL) tail (+~100
vs Equal-XNOR), Conv-1×1 plane mixer (tie at ~1.6k), INT8 planes (overflow +
opset-14 Add), Gather k-split (165 vs 90), single 2-ch einsum (+120), F16-arith
tail (v1, +769), LIVE's clamp chains (+14,9xx). 20 constructions priced total.

Bool-tail risk framing: traps §12 (task080 −13.32 LB) is the bool-reformulation
precedent, BUT its escape clause ("unless values provably 0/1") applies — these
bools are *defined* by tie-free comparisons on exact integers, not reinterpreted
floats — and the 2026-06-01 §NOVEL-OP doctrine gates on full-corpus byte-equality
(passed: 200,266/200,266), not op vocabulary. v1 (no bool tail) is still staged
as the safe primary; ladder order is in the manifests.

## Don't-do log

- **fp16_selective converter pass**: +64,140 bytes regression (spread sweep verdict). Hand-built F16 (v1) is the way, not the converter.
- **Don't re-clamp the planes to one-hot {0,1}**: the `>0.0` decode makes signed margins sufficient; clamp chains are pure waste (LIVE's 8 Sub + 5 Relu).
- **Don't fear ReduceProd F16 / Einsum `bchw,kjc->bkjw` / Pad F16 input-form on CPU EP**: all probed working (opset 12, ORT under ORT_DISABLE_ALL, 2026-06-06). ReduceProd is absent from the ort_reality reducer matrix but its F16 CPU kernel exists.
- **INT8 plane variant is dead**: needs ×2 scaling to avoid the 0-boundary (decode is >0), products reach ±441 > INT8 range; Add INT8 also needs opset 14+.
- **Sub-10×10 crop worries are moot**: generator emits exactly 10×10 always (200k corpus, min==max). No padding-column ambiguity exists in-distribution (out-of-distribution <10×10 grids would put ch0=1 on padding cells — LIVE has the identical behavior, byte-equal class preserved).
- **Don't split s1/s12 via a [1,2,...] stacked Greater** (200 B) — slicing counts BEFORE the row-broadcast (40 B each) is cheaper; and don't add a Not node for ch1 — swap Greater operand order instead.
- **Don't unpack n12 from packed via Sub/Div** — `Greater(100r+50, packed)` compares against packed directly (n1 ≤ 10 < 50 margin argument); only n1 needs the Mod.
- **Range op for the row ramp loses to an initializer**: Range = 3 params + 40 B output = 43 cost vs 10-param init.
- **Don't try sel-side column masking to kill the col-slice**: any per-column selector in the einsum is ≥ [10,30] = 300 params; the 3-param Slice wins.
